items.title: The Companies Selling Life Insurance and Annuities Pay Dividends Too. $55,000 in Each of These 3 Pays $5,451 a Year
items.summary: The insurers that collect your premiums and annuity deposits also send checks back to shareholders every quarter. One of three giants yields nearly twice what another pays, and a Japan sales suspension complicates the picture.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Deepens Japan Focus With Fresh Yen Bond Plans
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway plans its second yen bond sale of 2026, leveraging low borrowing costs and currency hedging to expand its Japanese investment strategy.

items.title: MetLife Forecasts CRE Returns Improving to 6.4% in 2027
items.summary: MetLife expects unleveraged CRE returns to rise from 5% this year to 6.4% in 2027 as limited construction supports income growth.

items.title: MetLife (MET) Agrees To Divest MetLife UK Limited
items.summary: MetLife (NYSE: MET) has agreed to sell MetLife UK Limited to life and pensions consolidator Chesnara. The proposed transaction will be subject to regulatory approvals and is expected to follow a multi year completion timeline. The deal marks a planned reduction of MetLife's UK presence as the insurer looks to concentrate on other international priorities.
